subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw core accept an authenticated Control UI dictation RPC that invokes the configured audio STT provider or local CLI, once the PR is ported and proven?
rationale: The implementation is a new user-facing core feature and Gateway provider/security boundary, and the paired issue is already marked as needing a product decision; code review can identify blockers but cannot choose that product boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Accept after port and proof
options.body: Land the Gateway-backed dictation feature after the current-main port, accessibility fix, docs-map refresh, green checks, and redacted real behavior proof are complete.

options.title: Defer to broader voice work
options.body: Keep this PR paused or close it in favor of resolving the broader provider-backed STT/TTS direction first.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that exposes only the reusable Gateway/API seam or only the current composer UI, leaving full dictation for a later decision.

recommendation.title: Accept after port and proof
recommendation.body: Land the Gateway-backed dictation feature after the current-main port, accessibility fix, docs-map refresh, green checks, and redacted real behavior proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They have both the prior server-side dictation history and the current chat composer refactor history.
